title: Growth pods and imprints
summary: The Civilian Center grows embryos into young adults. You choose their skill and what you teach them.
text:
The **Civilian Center** has two **growth pods**. Select it and tap **+ Grow colonist** to start one. You pick two things:

- A **specialty**: Engineer, Botanist, Medic, Technician or Security. Each works best in its own kind of building
- An **imprint**: what you teach them while they grow, since a pod can't give a childhood

The imprints:

- **Charter**: humans and the AI as partners, and an honest history of Earth
- **Heritage**: human history, art and self-reliance. Skilled and proud, wary of you
- **Guardian**: the AI as guardian and future. Tireless, and little interest in families

The imprint sets how far they trust you when they step out. A pod takes a sol (the first one half that) and needs **power and biomass the whole time**: about a minute without either and the child inside is lost.
